title: Chat header, the ⋮ chat menu, agent and group info, chat wallpaper
owns: the chat-menu, agent-info and members-permissions wiring in apps/web/src/shell/Shell.tsx
apps/web/src/conversation/wallpaper.ts and the wallpaper rules in conversation.css
the agent status line in packages/core

steps.name: info-and-menu
steps.lead_notes:
Five of these entries are one defect seen by different auditors: the chat header (avatar, name) and the ⋮ row «معلومات الوكيل» / «معلومات المجموعة» must take the owner to the agent page or the group page (see the contracts table), not open the old form in a sheet. Package `agent` runs at the same time and owns AgentPage, GroupPage and IdentityPage; it makes sure those pages offer everything the old forms did. You only change where the chat sends the owner. Do not delete the old form files (pages/shell/bot-settings.tsx, pages/GroupPanel.tsx and so on): a later cleanup removes files nothing imports. Do remove the imports and wrappers your change leaves unused.
The ⋮ menu becomes a popover beside its button, as in the reference, on phone and desktop. Use the existing popover hook. Package `popover` is adding Back and Esc handling inside shell/lists/Popover.tsx itself, so do not add your own history handling and do not edit Popover.tsx.
Menu contents follow the reference for an agent chat and for a group chat, minus what the owner decisions remove. «مسح المحادثة» is red, asks for confirmation, and uses the same hide-history path the chat list's clear action uses (Q1: nothing is deleted). «خلفية المحادثة» is added in the next step, with its sheet.
sheets_overlays-3: after the extra rows leave the menu, check whether anything else still opens Knowledge or Goals as an old screen inside a sheet; if a path remains, send it to the shell's own page.

gaps.title: Chat header avatar/name and ⋮ «معلومات الوكيل» open the old edit-form sheet, not the agent page

Route agent at 3639 shows hero, «محادثة · اتصال», then the rows. DESIGN_TREE_37.md:25-37 puts «معلومات الوكيل» under the chat.
gaps.app_evidence: ChatHeader.tsx:131,143 call onInfo. Shell.tsx:718 wires it to menu.openInfo. ChatMenu.tsx:243 openInfo calls openPage("info"), and ChatMenu.tsx:190 then mounts the legacy AgentSettings (pages/shell/bot-settings.tsx: AvatarStudio, scope select, broker picker, Name/Title/Description inputs, «Advanced» details, Save) inside a `.legacy-surface` bar sheet. The real AgentPage (/app/agent/:id) can only be reached from الوكلاء or a supervisor link. So the app has two agent-info surfaces. Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-lonorabot/5d377f24-3ac2-5c89-bb02-ed3686a435ad/scratchpad/audit/shots/agent/app-chat-avatar-p.png (bottom sheet), app-chat-avatar-d.png (centered dialog), versus app-agent-gold-p.png (the correct page).

It has no محادثة/اتصال buttons and no rows. The agent page that matches the reference is hidden two levels deep under the agents list.
gaps.fix_plan: In ChatMenu.tsx, drop the "info" MenuPage. Make openInfo and the ⋮ «معلومات الوكيل» row close the sheet and nav.go(`/app/agent/${agent.id}`), or `/app/group/${group.id}` for a group. Remove the AgentSettings and GroupSettings imports and bodies. Delete apps/web/src/pages/shell/bot-settings.tsx once nothing imports it, plus components/ai/AvatarStudio's studio UI (keep avatarFaceLabels) and components/ai/SupervisionSettings.tsx if they become unused. Update the Playwright specs that open the info sheet.
gaps.verifier_note: Route to /app/agent/:id (group to /app/group/:id) from openInfo and the ⋮ row. Before deleting bot-settings.tsx, verify every field AgentSettings edits (scope, broker account, name/title/description, advanced) is reachable from AgentPage via /app/identity/:id; otherwise a capability is lost. Keep the broker-link/trading safety guards intact. Shell.tsx:697 uses menu.openInfo for members-permissions, so overlaps gap 1. Update Playwright specs that open the info sheet; do not delete AvatarStudio/SupervisionSettings until grep shows no importers.

steps.name: wallpaper-and-status
steps.lead_notes:
The wallpaper choice is a per-device preference: store it the way the other device preferences are stored (find the existing module; do not add a second storage scheme). Build the sheet with the existing sheet system: the reference's patterns and intensity levels, the 0.3 s change fade, and the fade-in when a conversation opens. Add the «خلفية المحادثة» row to the ⋮ menu and to the settings root under the appearance group (SettingsRoot.tsx is edited by other packages too: keep your hunk to that one row).
chat_header-12: the status vocabulary lives in packages/core and is shared with mobile; keep `pnpm check` green for mobile.

Menu item 9257 `popItem("image","خلفية المحادثة","wall-sheet")`. DESIGN_TREE_37.md:96-97, 221, 285 «خلفية المحادثة | ظهور تدريجي | 0.3». Screenshot shots/chathead/ref-phone-wall.png
gaps.app_evidence: apps/web/src/conversation/Conversation.tsx:1011-1018 `<svg className="chat-wall" style={{"--wa": WALL_LEVELS.light.a[...]}}><rect fill="url(#lw-p-lonora)"/></svg>` fixed id and level; conversation/prefs.ts:5-13 CHAT_PREFS_DEFAULT has no wall key; no .wall-grid/.wall-opt/.wall-prev/wall-in CSS in apps/web/src (conversation.css:4706-4723 only #lw-defs and .chat-wall); wallpaper.ts:69-156 holds the five patterns and three levels with hard-coded Arabic names (not Lingui); ChatMenu.tsx has no «خلفية المحادثة» row

gaps.fix_plan: Add `wall: { id: "lonora", level: "light" }` to CHAT_PREFS_DEFAULT (per-device, as the capability map says). Export WALLS ids from wallpaper.ts and move the display names to Lingui (t`Lonora`, t`Agents`, t`Market`, t`Calm`, t`None`, t`Light`, t`Medium`, t`Stronger`). Conversation.tsx renders the svg from prefs.wall (nothing for "none") with className "chat-wall page-enter" on change. New conversation/sheets/WallSheet.tsx (useWallSheet) ported from wallSheet(): radiogroup grid of .wall-opt with .wall-art preview at scale(.6) and opacity min(.5, alpha*2.3), check on the chosen one, then «وضوح الرسومات» segmented .tabs disabled for none; selecting updates setChatPref live. The level alpha depends on the theme (light vs dark: WALL_LV a[1]/a[0]), keep that. The preview uses scale(.6) with opacity min(.5, alpha*2.3). Must not hurt message legibility: keep the layer behind the messages, aria-hidden. The «none» choice must disable the level tabs. The row in the ⋮ menu (gap 0) and the settings row (gap 4) depend on this sheet existing, so build it first.

gaps.title: The chat wallpaper does not fade in when a conversation opens
gaps.reference_evidence: Lonora-Desktop-37.html 850-851 `.chat-wall.page-enter{animation:wall-in .3s var(--ease) both}` `@keyframes wall-in{from{opacity:0}}`; 4950 the wall svg gets the same `${enter}` class as the page. DESIGN_TREE_37 «خلفية المحادثة | ظهور تدريجي | 0.3».
gaps.app_evidence: apps/web/src/conversation/Conversation.tsx:1011-1018 renders `<svg className="chat-wall">` with no enter class; conversation.css:4715-4723 has no animation, and no app CSS defines wall-in. Shell.tsx:730 adds page-enter only to main.

gaps.fix_plan: Add `.chat-wall.page-enter { animation: wall-in .3s var(--ease) both } @keyframes wall-in { from { opacity: 0 } }` to conversation.css and give the svg the `page-enter` class when the page enters (pass Shell's `enter` flag down, or add the class on mount). The global reduced-motion rule already turns it off.
gaps.verifier_note: Smallest fix is a `.chat-wall` animation in conversation.css (`wall-in .3s var(--ease) both`, keyframes `from{opacity:0}`). That needs no prop plumbing, but it would also replay on remounts that are not page enters, such as a conversation switch. If you want parity with the reference, pass Shell's enter flag down instead. The animation fills 'both', and the wall's `opacity: var(--wa)` is its resting state, so the keyframe must only use `from`. Check that `contain: strict` does not interfere.
